items.title: November 25, 2026
items.summary: BigQueryFeatureYou can use cross-cloud connections toquery data in AWS, Azure, and Salesforce Data 360 from all BigQuery regions withmore feature availability than standard connections that use BigQuery Omni. Thisfeature isgenerally available(GA).DeprecatedThe BigQuery Storage API v1beta1 is deprecated and will be shut down on August 31, 2027.Key milestone dates:Nov 20, 2026: Access to the BigQuery Storage API v1beta1 is restricted to projects that recorded active usage between March 1, 2026, and August 31, 2026.August 31, 2027: The BigQuery Storage API v1beta1 will be fully shut down. After this date, calls to the v1beta1 endpoint will fail with a NOT_FOUND error.What you need to do:To prevent service disruption, migrate your workloads from v1beta1 to the generally available BigQuery Storage API v1. The v1 API is backward-compatible with v1beta1.SDKs and connectors: If you use connectors or client libraries, update them to the latest versions to ensure they default to the v1 API:Simba ODBC/JDBC for BigQueryGoogle BigQuery ODBC / JDBC driverTrino BigQuery pluginApache Beam BigQuery connectorSpark BigQuery connectorScio BigQuery pluginCustom code: If your applications call the v1beta1 API directly (for example, using gRPC), update your code to target the v1 API endpoint (google.cloud.bigquery.storage.v1).For more information, see the BigQuery Storage API reference.If you are using v1beta1 and have concerns with this deprecation schedule, please contact us via a support case.
